> Reproduce and fix a regression

1. Create a minimal deterministic reproduction.
2. Add a failing regression test.
3. Find the first incorrect boundary or invariant.
4. Fix root cause without unrelated cleanup.
5. Run focused tests and complete validation.
6. Update compatibility or recovery docs when needed.
